review_evidence: Inventoried all 1,203 primary Agda files across Cubical's algebra, category theory, higher-inductive-type, homotopy, cohomology, data, modalities, reflection, tactics, papers, talks and experiment trees; mathematical examples, papers, talks and experiments remain searchable rather than being classified by path role.

Representative facade/base/property modules were inspected and retained; small canonical API modules were not treated as noise merely because they mainly re-export underlying constructions, since their module identities and interfaces carry useful formal-search signal.

Cubical/Codata/Everything.agda was inspected completely: after the guardedness option and module declaration it consists only of imports of Codata modules, with no definition, theorem, notation, alias, open/export command or proof; the repository also ships generate-everything.sh for this generated import surface.

rules.content_invariant: The selected file is a pure Codata import aggregator and owns no formal declaration or proof; every imported Codata source remains retained, while the file path/hash and review decision remain preserved as provenance.
evidence: Complete Cubical/Codata/Everything.agda inspection found only an OPTIONS pragma, module declaration and import statements.
The repository's generate-everything.sh establishes that Everything modules are generated navigation/import surfaces rather than owner modules.
rules.rationale: Remove the generated pure-import Codata aggregator from primary owner-result slots while retaining every substantive Codata module it imports.

summary: Reviewed Cubical conservatively across the complete primary Agda surface; retain its mathematical library, examples, papers, talks and experiments, excluding only the generated pure-import Codata Everything module.
